verifier_contract.collection_integrity: JUnit contains exactly 19 unique, passing, non-skipped cases for full reward.
behaviors: mixed full-attention and GDN workers initialize through the existing connector interface
full-attention, MLA, sliding-window MLA, and both GDN conv and temporal-state payloads reach their matching destination blocks
null state placeholders are ignored and unrequested bytes across complete backing allocations remain unchanged
padded attention views and production-shaped shared-page GDN views stay within valid registered memory
full-attention, MLA, and sliding-window MLA logical-to-physical block ratios greater than one do not overlap or corrupt neighboring blocks

e2e_boundary.path: hybrid KV configuration and P/D request metadata -> real Mooncake worker construction and registration -> real metadata encoding/decoding, group-aware transfer planning, and producer send lifecycle -> pointer-based copy into consumer CPU tensors and completion status
e2e_boundary.scheduler_composition: Cold token-ID, cold prompt-embedding, and warm-prefix cases enter through the real Scheduler.add_request, Scheduler.schedule, and Scheduler.update_from_output lifecycle. The token-ID and prompt-embedding cases also compare the retained public request input with the exact original prefix.
e2e_boundary.substitution: Deterministic CPU tensors replace model forward passes. Attention tensors preserve their declared physical layout, while GDN conv and temporal tensors are production-shaped as_strided views over one page-strided backing allocation. An in-memory engine replaces native Mooncake RDMA and validates registered ranges before performing the exact pointer-based copies requested by production connector code. A loopback socket replaces ZMQ transport while retaining production message encoding and response handling.
e2e_boundary.preserved_semantics: Cache group cardinality and order, full-attention and MLA logical-to-physical block identities, GDN shared-page shapes, offsets and strides, both recurrent-state payloads, complete backing bytes, null placeholders, registration ranges, failure codes, prompt element order, request completion, and cold/warm lifecycle state are preserved.
e2e_boundary.limitations: The verifier does not execute GPU kernels, model weights, native Mooncake RDMA/NVLink, multi-node transport, or full-model accuracy evaluation. It does not claim coverage for Mamba variants other than GDN.

independent_challenge.case: An unpublished ratio-five partial-prefix sliding-window MLA plus production-shaped shared-page GDN transfer with non-contiguous logical blocks.
